notes: One logical two-leg monthly gold/silver Conover scale-state reversion package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, paired costs, and activity; neither component leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA selects thirteen synchronized completed month-end gold-minus-silver log ratios, forms twelve adjacent changes in fixed old/recent blocks of six, separately mean-centers the blocks, strictly ranks pooled absolute deviations, sums squared ranks for the recent block, and audits the inclusive upper tail by enumerating all 924 six-rank labels. Score and tail_count are deterministic diagnostics/activity gates, not p-values.

The package targets equal absolute USD notionals, caps aggregate frozen-stop risk at one RISK_FIXED budget, and follows the validated QM5_12533 logical-basket host-symbol recipe with USD tester currency and the canonical 100000 deposit. Q09 alone owns realized portfolio correlation.
